chunks: What the Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me of, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah, that they two said:
Do not wash your garment from the urine of anything whose flesh is eaten.

key_terms.لَا تَغْسِلْ: Do not wash; an instruction indicating no obligation to cleanse in this case

ai.seo_question: Does urine from animals whose meat is lawful to eat make clothing najis?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity of clothing. It indicates that the urine of animals whose meat is lawful to eat does not require washing from one’s garment.
